Head-sha: `b671f83b397dd56675729934b968c8156db19cc8`

Reviewing seat: `domain:skills`, in-seat review at the contract-review tier — `get_session` read at 2026-09-15T07:15Z: `configured_model` = `session_context.model` = `last_served_model`, the constant's tier, no fallback notice this round. Card #18092 (a decision card RULED **A** by the director seat, 5682890409, batch #136 item 1, the maintainer's 「同意」), claim 5683666281, report 5684175190 (posted through the tool; read back `footer-appended`); `Clause-②: no` on the claim; the dev held at the review tier by the seat's judgment (rules layer); seat review at tier.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set / public surface: none moves — `AGENTS.md` (+4/−4, lines :441–:444 reflowed within the same sentence group, :440 byte-identical, 1075 → 1075 at the 1075 ceiling) against merge-base `10a7b9fa`; nothing published; `skip-changeset` read back. Rules layer ⇒ four-piece: this record, the 速读终稿 below, ACCEPT on the card, `needs-user-decision` + reviewers; lands by ruling C after an authorized APPROVED review.
- The change, read in full on a detached worktree of the head: the comment rule's sentence group now reads 「…no model identifier lands in a PR title or body, a comment, a changeset, a doc or a code comment. Two exemptions: a harness-written `Co-Authored-By` trailer (REPORTING: not declared a deviation; landed history is not rewritten) and a verbatim maintainer ruling preserved as a quotation block.」 — the ruling's letter A verbatim for the exemption; the identifier in a seat's own prose stays a violation by the unchanged first clause. Payment at the ceiling: the restated clause 「the pair stays model-free;」 (27 B) dropped — :440 (the model-free trailer pair) and :442 (the hook refuses an identifier in that pair) already say it; the reflow frees no line. Every line ≤120 B (77 / 115 / 116 / 119 / 110 measured by the seat and the dev).
- The probe half, measured by the dev and accepted by the seat: NO repository code reads prose for model identifiers — `check-commit-card-trailers.mjs` judges the trailer value only (:848's four ids are self-test fixtures), the pre-push hook invokes that gate, `check-agent-model-declared.mjs` reads the frontmatter pin, `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` / `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` judge the single `Served-tier:` token, H64 keys on session ids, H65 on a tier name, hooks / lint scripts / workflows carry no identifier regex, and no 型号探针 recipe exists in the skill tree — the counts the card feared were seat hand-greps. So the ruling's probe clause has no code to land in; the PR is the sentence alone, which the dispatch named as a legitimate outcome. The quotation form on the live posts: every identifier-carrying preserved ruling is a 「」 span labelled 原话照抄不译 (#6015 L128 / L130, #6021 L24 / L34 / L136), none a blockquote; the ratchet's own `EXEMPTION_CLASSES` already treat both forms as verbatim rulings.
- Gates 14 / 14 / 0 / 0 by `--ran` on the merge head (the battery not derived); seat re-run on the detached worktree: the same 14 derived commands 14 / 14 green, `check:pm-skill-ratchet` 「AGENTS.md is 1075 lines (ceiling 1075; headroom 0)」 with no width offender, `--pair 18315` 0; every check on the head green (2026-09-15T16:41Z reading in the 速读 below). Reverse verification by the dev: ablation with blob hashes (base `7c7a5eee` restored — sentence count 0, restated clause 1; HEAD `98e7cd4a` restored — sentence 1, clause 0; `git diff HEAD` empty); no pure-predicate pair because no probe changed.

### ② Semver level

Not applicable — nothing published moves; `skip-changeset` measured.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: none. Seat premises the dev refuted, owned here: (1) 「a long prose line is legal in AGENTS.md」 — false: the 14 over-width lines are table rows and the v5.0 blockquote (`EXEMPTION_CLASSES`); `lengthVerdict` holds every prose line to 120 B; (2) 「a same-paragraph line can be paid」 — false, none subsumed, so the payment is the restated clause; (3) the session branch was `2bf6ef18` at dispatch, `6ef33128` / `10a7b9fa` by the time the worktree was cut and merged — `AGENTS.md` untouched by both. Six deviations answered: content payment instead of the two named routes — accepted, the maintainer edits wording at review; the 原话照抄不译 act-name left out of the sentence (27 B short at the ceiling) — accepted, it lives on the card and in the PR body, and a ruled +1 on the ceiling is the maintainer's call; :441 reflowed with :442–:444 — accepted, same sentence group; no probe change / no case — accepted, measured; a `tail --pid` that waited on the asking shell — a dev-side process note, no process killed by name; `Co-Authored-By` capitalised as the dispatch spelled it while :441 spells the key lower-case — the pre-push gate accepted it; noted for the seat's dispatch template. Out of scope, noted: the ruling's H64 clause has no code to land in (the director seat's to hear); the width rule for future AGENTS.md dispatches. Landing: ruling C after an authorized APPROVED review by os-zhuang / hotlong — record on this head, `--pair` 0, checks green, clear `needs-user-decision`, ready through the CCR route, auto-merge SQUASH; the seat never approves.

## 维护者速读(终稿)— PR #18315 / #18092

**改了什么**:AGENTS.md 第 442–444 行的评论规则加一句闭合豁免——「逐字保存为引用块的维护者裁决」不算违规;席位自己在正文里写的型号仍算违规(第一句未动)。措辞照总监席裁决 A 的原文;行数 1075 不变,代价是删掉了一句重复的「the pair stays model-free」(第 440、442 行已各说一遍)。

**为什么没有改探针**:dev 逐个测过仓内所有可能读型号的代码——commit trailer 门、pre-push hook、agent 定义 `model:` 门、clause-2 与队列守卫(只读一个 `Served-tier:` token)、H64(按 session id)、H65(按层名)、hooks / lint / workflows——**没有一个读散文找型号**。过去把保存的裁决数成违规的是席位手工 grep,不是仓库代码。所以裁决里「探针排除引用块」这半句没有可落的代码,PR 只有这一句话。

**要你做的**:审 PR #18315 的措辞与位置(裁决说了由你在 review 时改),同意即 APPROVE;之后由本席按裁定 C 落地。若你想把「原话照抄不译」四字也写进句子,需要把 AGENTS.md 上限抬 1 行(现 1075/1075),那是你的裁定。

**其他**:席位派发前提有两处被 dev 证伪(AGENTS.md 散文行也受 120 字节宽度限制;同段无可删行),已记入记录 5684207107。
